issues.where: below the Email field, where Continue sits at rest
issues.what: Opening the keyboard removes the only visible way to advance. The keyboard shows Enter but gives no indication that it closes the panel, commits the field, or advances the form.
issues.fix: Keep Continue visible when the keyboard is open, or give the keyboard an explicit close control that restores Continue without clearing the active field.

issues.where: the Last name label in the native-size field crop, and the same pattern above Email on the full page
issues.what: Each new label sits at least as close to the preceding field or helper as to its own input, making the form stack harder to scan.
issues.fix: Use a tighter label-to-input gap and a clearly larger gap between field groups, treating the first-name helper as part of its field.

issues.where: the Browse files button in the drop-zone crop
issues.what: The cream label is readable, but its contrast against the mid-gray key face is weak for the upload area's only button.
issues.fix: Darken the button face behind the lettering while retaining the bevel, and target at least 4.5:1 text contrast.

issues.where: the shredder mount at the bottom-right edge of the upload tray
issues.what: The tray's bevel continues unbroken behind the shredder, so the mechanism reads as a separate bracket beneath the tray rather than something emerging from it.
issues.fix: Interrupt the bevel at the mount and give the shredder a recessed opening with tight contact shadow where it meets the tray.
